en: %s begs to be put out of his misery.
%s and Raider Kerr charge into battle...
I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $n.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.
I have failed once more...
The battle goes well. The Scourge forces seem weakened. I believe it will only be a matter of time before we drive them from our shores. I will turn my magics to you, to aid in this struggle.

That's right, um, $g lad : lass;, all of the war materiel is being transported to Silithus and the last of it should get there within $2113w days. After that, we'll all just have to wait and see who puts forth a $g hero : heroine; to reconstitute the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais. Only when that occurs will the war begin to open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj.
Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.
Please, do not bother me... Your kind is all the same...

Woo hoo, here we go! Everyone's collected everything, and it's all being airlifted via zeppelin to Silithus as we speak. The last of it should be there in less than $2113w days. Once it's all over there, and the scepter has been assembled, the war against those dirty insects can begin. As they say, 'Ship It!'

Greetings, $Gsir:miss;. I am Master Xylem's apprentice Nyrill. If you have any concerns, please feel free to bring them up with the master.$B$BI will be here to serve you when you're ready to return down to the base of the mountain.
We am free! Thank you little, puny ones.
Yes, I think you have potential. Maybe I can show you a thing or two.
I am in search of a great and powerful Warlock.
Master Vectus, I sense something strange within this container...
Wolves head this way, as if fleeing from...something.

Simply stated, this is correct.$B$BThe Earthen's physical features are that of a smaller stature humanoid, though their composition is that of Azeroth's various stone core compounds.  Their design maximizes strength and stamina without sacrificing cognitive processing power.  Their skin and musculature are nearly impervious to physical damage, and with very minor modifications the Earthen display a remarkable resiliency to unwanted magical forces.
Southshore stout, how do I love thee? Let me count the ways...
We need to get this wagon filled by the end of the day.  So back to work with you.  Chop, chop!
The Iceblood Graveyard was taken by the Horde!
Leave your battles or errands, and browse my incredible wares! Only in Darkshire for a short time... praise the Light for that.

Greetings, $n. I am Johnny McWeaksauce. I am used as a tool by developers to carry out specific functions for the purpose of testing. For this test period, I am set to do two specific things:$B$B(1) Flag you as having done the Naxxramas attunement quest so that you are able to accept the next quest, "Echoes of War" from Commander Eligor Dawnbringer. You must first complete that quest to be able to access the quests for your Tier 3 armor set.$B$B(2) Teleport you to Naxxramas.$B$BWhat is it that you require?
What's that noise?
Nothing biting. . . .
If you not talk to Mizzle, you not become da king!  Take to Mizzle da Crafty!
Usurper?
What!?
Be silent!  Do you think our plagued dragons will hatch and train themselves?
Let's start a new battle, and beat the Alliance this time!
Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?

Some say that strength and bravery are most needed for an army's success.  And it's true!  But an army also needs supplies to keep itself in good shape, and it's my job to make sure they have what they need.
I have another question.

If yer of need of an Inn, The Stonefire Inn is where ye should be.  Ye'll find it just to the left of the entrance to Ironforge if ye be coming, or to the right if ye be going.  $B$BOh, and if yer going that way, then tell them to have a tankard ready for me.
Straight from the lush forests of Elwynn, get your fresh fruit right here.
Gryfe do his job! Gryfe go now!!!
Bagh! Back to work for me! Thank you kindly Belm.
That's it!  I'm tired of helping you out.  It's time we settled things on the battlefield!
Hoary Templar!  I hold your crest of beckoning.  Heed my summons!
But wouldn't that mean crossing the streams? Isn't that really bad?
Hip hip... arrrrr...
Thank you, $n. My torment is now at an end.
